_doc: A turntable of real renders (cad/viewer/turntable.py <step> printer). views: frame_view.py --turntable; render: render.py options (owner's look 2026-11-17: AgX Punchy, plastic 0.2, -1.4 EV; the key light turns and tilts with each camera); page: the page's text (platform/viewer/turntable_page.py); publish: where the public page goes. The base board is hidden: the turntable is about the printer, not the plank.

page.title: VT350 ·
page.model_note: the printer with its e-box and EMU
page.foot: Real Blender Cycles renders (render.py, the render colour map, AgX Punchy, −1.4 EV), one every 10° round the printer at seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above, without the base board it stands on. The light turns with the camera. Drag sideways to turn it, up or down to change the height; arrow keys work too.

publish.blurb: 252 Blender Cycles renders of the whole VT350 with its e-box and EMU: drag round it at 36 angles and seven heights, from 40° below to 40° above.
